findings.message: The vigraha puts members and whole in the masculine (गुणागारः, संसारपारः, असौ, तम्) but mw-agara.md gives āgāra as n., w8 components list āgāra and pāra as neuter, and p10 tags the compound neuter accusative. Human should decide which gender is intended.
findings.suggested_fix: Neuter: गुणानाम् आगारम् गुणागारम्, संसारस्य पारम् संसारपारम्; गुणागारं च तत् संसारपारं च. Or make p10 masculine and say so in the note.
